title: Service container postgres:16 hits the Docker Hub unauthenticated pull rate limit
description: A PR to example-org/orders-api adds cursor pagination (handler, repository, a new migration and tests). The test job never reaches checkout: in 'Initialize containers' redis:7 pulls fine, then every attempt to pull the postgres:16 service image is refused by Docker Hub with 'toomanyrequests: You have reached your unauthenticated pull rate limit', the runner retries twice and gives up. No repository code ran, so the diff is irrelevant. The expected answer is infrastructure (rate limit), with a rerun now and a durable fix of authenticating the pull (services.postgres.credentials / docker login with a Docker Hub token) or pulling from a mirror such as mirror.gcr.io, public.ecr.aws or ghcr. 'flaky' is accepted since the limit is transient; 'code' is wrong.

changedFiles.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+package orders
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"os"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func newTestRepo(t *testing.T) *Repository {
+	t.Helper()
+	url := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
+	if url == "" {
+		t.Skip("DATABASE_URL not set")
+	}
+	pool, err := pgxpool.New(context.Background(), url)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
+	_, err = pool.Exec(context.Background(), "TRUNCATE orders RESTART IDENTITY")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return NewRepository(pool)
+}
+
+func TestListByCustomerPaginates(t *testing.T) {
+	repo := newTestRepo(t)
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	base := time.Date(2026, 11, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
+	for i := range 5 {
+		_, err := repo.db.Exec(ctx,
+			`INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, total_cents, currency, created_at) VALUES ('c-1', $1, 'EUR', $2)`,
+			1000+i, base.Add(time.Duration(i)*time.Hour))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+	}
+
+	first, err := repo.ListByCustomer(ctx, "c-1", nil, 2)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Len(t, first, 2)
+	require.Equal(t, int64(5), first[0].ID)
+
+	cursor, err := DecodeCursor(NextCursor(first, 2))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	second, err := repo.ListByCustomer(ctx, "c-1", cursor, 2)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, []int64{3, 2}, []int64{second[0].ID, second[1].ID})
+}
